_comment: Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in your actual values. NEVER commit local.settings.json to version control.

Values._comment_storage: Azure Storage connection string - get from Azure Portal > Storage Account > Access Keys
Values._comment_jwt: JWT signing secret - generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(64).toString('hex'))"
Values._comment_cors: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS
Values._comment_email: Azure Communication Services for sending emails (optional)
